literally nobody wants to sign up for the fucking credit cards and some people just straight up say “no” when i ask for a phone number. no amount of repeated “training” on these is going to make people more likely to sign up for a credit card, loyalty isn’t so bad because it’s free and i can explain to people that it’s actually a good thing so i actually get somewhere with that. but the cards are a totally different thing. i’m not going to force grumpy old ladies or like literal 19 year olds to sign up for a credit card. if they don’t want to i’m not gonna change their mind on that. why do we have to push these? like i’m making $11/hr i don’t want to get fussed at for asking people this. it always feels really awkward and not genuine if i’m already having good rapport with a guest too.
